info.title: Baywatch partner API
info.summary: Let drivers in your charging app book a Baywatch bay, or any public charger, through Baywatch.
info.description:
Other charging apps (eMSPs) book bays for their own drivers with OCPI 2.2.1-style commands. `location_id` is the bay id: `bw-1`, `bw-2`, `bw-3` (the Baywatch bays, guarded by Ecurious locks) or `ge-<id>` (a GoingElectric charger, with a simulated guard). Slots start on the quarter hour (Berlin time) and last whole 15-minute blocks, up to 60 days ahead.

**Flow**
1. `GET /api/bays/{id}/quote?start&blocks` (public): the fee for that slot, whether it can be booked, and the cancellation schedule.
2. Show the price to the driver. Once they accept, `POST /ocpi/2.2.1/commands/RESERVE_NOW` with their plate, their consent to plate recognition, the slot and that price.
3. Poll `GET /api/partner/v1/reservations/{reservation_id}` for the status: no callbacks are sent.
4. `UPCOMING` → `LIVE` (30 min before the start) → `ARRIVED` (the camera read the plate) → `CHARGING` → `COMPLETED`. While it is `UPCOMING` or `LIVE`, `CANCEL_RESERVATION` frees the bay.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Token <token>`. OCPI 2.2.1 sends the token Base64-encoded; a plain token works too. Ask the Baywatch team for a token, and keep it on your server.

**Every partner answer** uses the OCPI envelope: `{ data, status_code, status_message, timestamp }`.

**Personal data:** you send the plate only so the camera can match the car. It is erased when the booking ends. Your app collects the driver's consent, and a data processing agreement with Baywatch is needed before going live.

Version 2.0.0 is a breaking change: `ecurious_session_minutes` was replaced by `ecurious_start` and `ecurious_blocks`, `location_id` is the bay id, and the statuses are new. The full integration guide is `docs/api.md` in the project repository.

get.description: Every GoingElectric charger in the box is bookable (`bays`, simulated guard), and the Baywatch bays come always (`realBays`), whatever the box. Charger data from GoingElectric, under their terms: don’t bulk-export it.
The bay and its 15-minute blocks for today (Berlin time).
free, booked, gap (too close to a booking for the 10-min gap) or past.
The reservation fee for that slot (€5 × class × demand at the start, at most €10), whether it can be booked and why not, and what cancelling costs from when on. Send `cents` as `ecurious_fee_cents`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The slot start in ms, on the quarter hour. Or `now`: "Book now", from the 15-minute block under way, for at least an hour from this moment; the answer's `start` and `end` say what that is.

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: The length in 15-minute blocks. Required unless `start=now`, which ignores it.

post.summary: Reserve the bay for one of your drivers
post.description:
OCPI ReserveNow plus `ecurious_` extension fields. The slot is `ecurious_start` for `ecurious_blocks` 15-minute blocks (defaults: the current block, the class maximum). The guard is up from 10 min before the start (at once for a slot starting sooner, when a car over the arm refuses the booking), and the car must arrive by `ecurious_arrive_by` (start + 15 min); a later `expiry_date` doesn’t extend that.

Sending the same `reservation_id` again while the booking is active returns ACCEPTED and changes nothing, so retries are safe. OCPI’s replace isn’t supported: cancel and book with a new id instead.

Well-formed requests the bay can’t take (taken, another location, the price changed, the hardware refused) get HTTP 200 with `result: REJECTED` and the reason in `message`.

200.description: The command was processed: ACCEPTED, or REJECTED with the reason.

message.text: Booked. Arrive by 2026-10-24T14:45:00.000Z: the camera checks the car in by its plate.

hardwareRefused.summary: The bay's hardware said no, with its reason

message.text: The bay could not be reserved: A car is over the arm, so it was not raised
Unknown location_id: use a Baywatch bay (bw-1, bw-2, bw-3) or a GoingElectric charger (ge-<id>)

priceChanged.summary: Demand moved the price since the driver saw it

message.text: The price is now €7.50. Check it and book again.

taken.summary: The slot overlaps another booking (or its 10-min gap)

message.text: Taken: this slot overlaps another booking or its 10-minute gap

post.summary: Cancel one of your reservations before the driver arrives
post.description: Works only on your own bookings, and only while they are UPCOMING or LIVE: once the camera has checked the car in, the session ends when the car leaves. Cancelling is free within 2 min of booking, 24 h or more before the start, and while another car blocks the bay; otherwise 10% of the fee from 24 h before, 50% from 30 min before and 80% from 5 min before. `ecurious_fee_cents` is what the booking costs in the end.

200.description: The command was processed: ACCEPTED, or REJECTED with the reason.

message.text: Cancelled, the bay is free again. No fee.

notYours.summary: Unknown id, or another partner's reservation

checkedIn.summary: The car is already in the bay

message.text: The driver has already checked in. The session ends when the car leaves.

hardwareRefused.summary: The arm could not be lowered: the booking stays, try again

message.text: Could not release the bay: The last bay command failed, try again in 20 s

get.summary: Status of one of your reservations (poll this)
get.description: The polling alternative to OCPI CommandResult callbacks: we never call partner-supplied URLs. Poll every 10 to 30 seconds while the reservation is active; the limit is 60 requests a minute per partner, commands included. Other partners' reservations answer 404.

parameters.name: reservation_id
parameters.description: The reservation_id you sent with RESERVE_NOW (case-insensitive, URL-encoded)

cancelled.summary: Cancelled within the free minutes: plate erased, fee refunded

lines.label: Refund: cancelled within 2 min of booking

upcoming.summary: Booked, more than 30 min before the start

404.description: Not one of your reservations, or too old to still be kept

get.summary: Public page for one bay (share it, link to it)
get.description: Shows the bay’s name, power, live availability and price, with one way in, which opens `/explore?bay={location_id}&reserve=1`. Signed-out visitors sign in first and come straight back. OpenGraph and Twitter tags make the link preview well in chats. For a "Book with Baywatch" button in your app, link here: it is the stable public URL, and a future native app takes it over as a universal / app link.

404.description: No such bay on this server

get.summary: The app's map, opened on a bay
get.description: `/explore?bay={location_id}` selects the bay on the map; `&reserve=1` also opens the booking dialog. Needs a signed-in Baywatch account: signed-out visitors are redirected to sign-in and back (HTTP 307).

post.description: Baywatch-internal: plate events from a camera source other than an Ecurious lock. A plate matching the bay’s live booking checks the driver in, whichever app made the booking. Bays with a real Ecurious lock refuse these (403): they take only their own camera, through the lock’s event stream. Partners never call this. Fails closed: with no `WEBHOOK_SECRET` configured, every event is rejected.

get.summary: Public settings for the Baywatch Flutter app
get.description: Baywatch-internal: the server's `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values, which are public by design, so the Flutter app signs in to the same Clerk instance this server checks tokens against, and shows the voice mic only when a Vapi assistant is set. Never a secret. Partners don't need it.

vapi.description: The voice assistant, or null when voice isn't set up

partnerToken.name: Authorization
partnerToken.description: `Token <token>`. OCPI 2.2.1 Base64-encodes the token; a plain token is accepted too. One token per partner app, issued by the Baywatch team. Compared in constant time; a missing or unknown token is 401.

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Shared secret between a camera source and this app

CiString36.description: OCPI CiString(36): printable ASCII without spaces, compared case-insensitively

status_code.description: 1000 success (a REJECTED command is still 1000); 2000 client error (token, unknown id, rate limit); 2001 invalid or missing parameters; 3000 server error

timeout.description: Always 0: this answer is final and no CommandResult follows

ecurious_arrive_by.description: RESERVE_NOW, ACCEPTED: the car must reach the bay by then (start + 15 min), or it counts as a no-show

ecurious_fee_cents.description: RESERVE_NOW: the reservation fee. CANCEL_RESERVATION: what the booking costs after cancelling (0 = free)

ecurious_end.description: RESERVE_NOW, ACCEPTED: the slot’s end (ms); idle fees from 5 min after it

OcpiToken.description: OCPI 2.2.1 Token. We use `uid` to tell your drivers apart (no-show history, one booking at a time) and check `type`, `contract_id` and `valid`. Other fields are accepted and ignored; nothing but `uid` is stored.

uid.description: Stable id of the driver's token in your system. Use one per driver: no-show history is kept per uid.

ReserveNow.description: OCPI 2.2.1 ReserveNow with Baywatch extension fields (prefix `ecurious_`).

response_url.description: Accepted for OCPI compatibility and never called: we don't make requests to partner-supplied URLs

expiry_date.description: Must be in the future. The hold ends at `ecurious_arrive_by` in the answer (booking + arrival grace), whatever this says.

reservation_id.description: Your id for this reservation, unique per reservation. Reusing it while active is a safe retry; after the reservation ended it is REJECTED.

location_id.description: The bay id: bw-1, bw-2, bw-3, or ge-<id> from GET /api/bays. Another id is REJECTED.

evse_uid.description: Optional. If sent, the bay id plus -1, e.g. bw-1-1.

ecurious_license_plate.description: The plate the camera will read. Spaces and dashes don't matter: 2 to 10 letters and digits.

ecurious_plate_consent.description: You confirm that the driver agreed to plate recognition for this booking

ecurious_start.description: Optional: the start in ms, on the quarter hour (Berlin time), at most 60 days ahead. Default: the current block if it began under 5 minutes ago, else the next one.

ecurious_blocks.description: Optional: the length in 15-minute blocks, up to 16 (slow), 8 (fast) or 4 (ultra-fast). Default: that maximum.

ecurious_fee_cents.description: The fee the driver accepted: `cents` from GET /api/bays/{id}/quote. A different price now is REJECTED with the new one.

response_url.description: Accepted for OCPI compatibility and never called

status.description: UPCOMING: booked. LIVE: from 30 min before the start until the car arrives (the guard is up from 10 min before). ARRIVED: the camera checked the car in and lowered the guard. CHARGING. COMPLETED: the car left. CANCELLED. NO_SHOW: nobody arrived by arrive_by: the whole fee is kept.

arrive_by.description: start + 15 min; moves later while another car blocks the bay

session_end.description: After this plus 5 min, idle fees apply: €0.30 a started minute, at most €12

bay_blocked.description: Another car is in the bay: the arrival deadline waits, the operator is alerted, and cancelling is free

license_plate_hint.description: Masked plate (MA•••34); null once the reservation has ended and the plate is erased

total_cents.description: What this booking costs so far, refunds included. Invoiced to the partner.

cents.description: The reservation fee: send it as ecurious_fee_cents

creditAppliedCents.description: Baywatch drivers’ credit; always 0 for partners

reason.description: Why not valid: off the grid, too long, too far ahead, overlapping, the 3-booking limit

bayId.description: Which bay (default bw-1). Bays with a real Ecurious lock refuse these: they take only their own camera (403).

plate.description: What the camera read. Empty: it saw a car but couldn't read the plate.

id.description: The location_id: bw-1 … bw-3, or ge-<GoingElectric id>

class.description: By the highest power: under 50 kW slow (4 h max), 50–299 kW fast (2 h), 300 kW and up ultra-fast (1 h)

real.description: One of the three Baywatch bays

guard.description: hardware: a real Ecurious lock. A Baywatch bay with a simulated guard has no hardware assigned yet.

status.description: Now. reserved: a booking is live; occupied: a car is in the bay; offline: the lock is offline, or GoingElectric reports a fault

led.description: green: a driver at the bay could unlock it now (walk-up)

nextBookingAt.description: ms: the start of the next booking

priceFromCents.description: The lowest reservation fee for this bay

state.description: gap: free, but too close to a booking (10-min gap)

blocks.description: 96 a day; 92 or 100 on the daylight-saving days

maxBlocks.description: The longest booking on this bay: 16, 8 or 4 blocks

from.description: ms: from then on, cancelling costs this

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed

Unauthorized.description: Missing or unknown token. No partners configured on the server also means 401.

InvalidCommand.description: Malformed request: a field is missing or invalid. Fix the request; retrying it as is won't help.

message.text: ecurious_license_plate is required: the plate the camera will read

TooManyRequests.description: More than 60 requests in a minute from this partner

example.status_message: Too many requests. Try again in 42 s.

HardwareDown.description: The bay's hardware did not answer: a timeout or a dropped connection. Nothing was booked or cancelled; try again in a minute. When the hardware answers with a reason (a car over the arm, the bay offline), you get a 200 REJECTED with that reason instead.

message.text: The bay’s hardware did not respond. Try again in a minute.

AppError.description: Error from the app API: `{ error }` with the matching HTTP status
